For those of you considering attending Devconnect, tickets for the co-work space were released today. We will likely be providing tickets to <@&857649635274915900> but you might considering securing one, just in case. They are 10 euro. https://devconnect.org/cowork Would it be possible for you to expand more on the kind of support fellows would get for DevConnect? We might have to start planning air tickets etc to get better deals 🙂 Fellows will be provided with air travel and hotel accommodations for the duration of the event. Nice. Was also curious about retroactive funding for permissionless fellows. Are you planning it this year as well? Yes, we are planning to take a look at retroactive stipends in the next couple of weeks, once projects are underway. Got it, thanks is the source code of a project need to be opensource ? <@686695036733227017> <@914307919699406908> Yes, all EPF projects should be created in an open source manner Ok thank you for the answer, I asked the question cause my project is security related and if its opensource it can help people with bad intentions Hnnm, interesting its the fuzzing project there is public fuzzer online but asked cause i saw that one got private (the one by sigma prime) because the fuzzer has found many crits. In case you find some vulnerability, follow disclosure policy of the relevant project. But all the tooling etc needs to be free and open, check for example https://choosealicense.com to find what license suits your project thank you 🙂 thank you so much everyone listen ed to my presentation! huge thanks to our heros <@914307919699406908> and <@686695036733227017> , specially for encouraging me to present !! I've added my presentation link: https://github.com/sogolmalek/EIP-x/blob/main/Project%20proposal.md. Ill update my PR and work on my codes furthermore! appreciate comments to improve my work and keen for collab 🙂 ahaha i think you wanted to tag <@686695036733227017> yes sry :)) but great presentation anyway ! thanks so much <@1032999166336585831> best of luck for your project and looking very forward to hear your presentation /see your progress 🙂 thank you! Here is the recording for the office hours meeting today. https://drive.google.com/file/d/11w169ZK3DDnjgsgZyXDR7uwLPaOGCVpZ/ Here are my slides from this morning `:)` https://github.com/eth-protocol-fellows/cohort-four/blob/master/notes/danielrachi/daniel-project-proposal-slides.pdf Hey <@486477492434239488> , i'm building a fuzzer for the epf and in order to connect to ethereum and send messages i'm going to use some code of reth ( the network crate ) . If i have some quick questions in the future can i ask you and add you in the mentors list of my project proposal ? Btw , i already talked with matthias in tg and he sent me files to explore from the reth repo.
